posts.text:
IMO Mastodon is the gold standard for controlling your own content destiny at the moment

Very flexible filters, per-account settings, and lots of ways to hide/block. Also gives you the option to collapse certain posts/reposts

Probably more than most people need but dearly appreciated regardless
